says: clauderow.ts refuses the transcript of a subagent that stopped on a usage limit, so that run gets no field row unless its last line is cut out by hand.
proof: A subagent stopped by the usage limit ends with an assistant message whose model is '<synthetic>' and whose usage is all zero; clauderow.ts on that transcript printed 'clauderow: no list price for <synthetic>' and wrote no row. With that one line dropped it wrote the row.
cost: Each run stopped by a limit is lost from field/runs or needs a hand edit of its transcript, so cost and stop counts undercount exactly the runs that failed.
